levels.title: THE GATEKEEPER
levels.briefing: SharkByte reaches the gates of the Infernal Citadel. Bullet stands in his way. Win the duel and follow the crimson trail into the forest.
levels.victory: Bullet steps aside. Beyond the citadel, red leaves glow in the dark. Nachtelf is waiting.

levels.title: WHISPERS IN THE FOREST
levels.briefing: Glowing mushrooms light SharkByte's path beneath the crimson leaves. Nachtelf guards the heart of the forest. Defeat him to discover where the living ship has landed.
levels.victory: The forest falls quiet. A strange green light reveals the entrance to Spinegrin's living ship.

levels.title: THE LIVING SHIP
levels.briefing: SharkByte boards a ship that breathes. Red tissue and green veins pulse around its bridge. Spinegrin attacks before SharkByte can reach the vessel's secrets.
levels.victory: Spinegrin yields. The ship's final signal points to a mine filled with glowing pink diamonds.

levels.title: THE HEART OF THE MINE
levels.briefing: Deep inside Crystal Fang zijn mijn, pink diamonds illuminate the stone. Crystal Fang protects the mine's heart. This duel decides the end of SharkByte's first journey.
levels.victory: The diamonds settle and the mine grows still. SharkByte has overcome all four guardians. Chapter One is complete.
